purpose: Keep T2 recall broad, but prevent one hot subchain from flooding the formal common qualification pool with near-duplicate companies.

weekly_deep_review.rule: A company independently validated by the weekly deep review remains eligible. It consumes a representative slot for any T2 subchain it belongs to, so the T2-only path cannot refill the same chain with duplicates.

ranking.rule: The representative step ranks only companies that already passed the company-level future-earnings gate. It does not use valuation or right-side technical structure, preserving stage independence.

output_policy.rule: Deferred companies remain visible in future_earnings_gate for auditability but are excluded from common_pool_codes. A company exposed to multiple T2 chains is retained if it wins a representative slot in any one chain.
